diagnosis: Folliculotropic mycosis fungoides, early, with follicular mucin
legend: Small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes, epitheliotropic to follicular epithelium, and sebaceous gland structures. Mucin pools are present.
Medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with Pautrier microabscess and a diffuse band-like involvement of the papillary dermis.
Diffuse sheets of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic convoluted nuclei.
Diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic atypical nuclei.

Atypical lymphoid infiltrate with epidermotropism. The lymphocytes are arranged as a superficial perivascular infiltrate in the papillary dermis. The intraepidermal lymphocytes form collections (Pautrier microabscesses). Tumour cells display hyperchromatic, irregular, convoluted/cerebriform nuclei surrounded by a clear halo. The papillary dermis is fibrotic.
